subject: Key lifecycle and evidence request for SOC2 / SIG review
messages:
From: Alex R. <security.audit@aurelia.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: security-team@aurelia.com
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Key lifecycle artifacts for SOC2/SIG review

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for agreeing to support our upcoming SIG/SOC2 supplemental. To complete the encryption piece of our control set we need the following artifacts from Redwood (for the tenant "Aurelia Financial"):

- KMS inventory (key IDs, creation dates, key usage: data encryption/CMK/KEK)
- HSM attestation (latest available) and vendor statement of attestation date
- Key rotation schedule and last-rotation timestamps for active KEKs/CMKs in production
- Sample access logs showing KMS/Admin operations (create/rotate/decrypt) for a 30-day window (redact tenant data identifiers as needed)
- BYOK handshake logs for tenant-supplied keys (where applicable)

Would you be able to provide those files or point us at a secure delivery link? Also let us know estimated turnaround — we're aiming to finalize the report by next Wednesday.

Best,
Alex
Security Assurance, Aurelia Financial


From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Alex R. <security.audit@aurelia.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Key lifecycle artifacts for SOC2/SIG review

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide these. Quick clarifications so we deliver precisely what you need:

1) KMS inventory: do you need tenant-scoped key IDs only (Aurelia-prefixed) or a CSV that maps internal keystore IDs to tenant association? We can provide either; we typically redact service-account ARNs in cross-tenant exports.
2) Access logs: we will provide operator-level logs with tenant-scoped request_ids redacted. Confirm that timestamps in UTC are fine.
3) BYOK: we have two tenants with BYOK so we'll pull the handshake excerpts for Aurelia only.

Planned delivery: preliminary package by EOD tomorrow, final signed HSM attestation and rotation-schedule snapshot by end of day Friday. We'll upload to a secure ShareFile link and send the token.

Attaching a short manifest of items we'll include.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_manifest.txt (text)


From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai; jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Key lifecycle artifacts for SOC2/SIG review

Jasmine — tagging in operational owners. Action items I'm taking:

- Generate KMS key inventory export (kms_key_inventory.csv). Will include: key_id, created_at (UTC), key_alias, usage (DATA_KEY/WRAPPING), key_state, tenant_tag.
- Export rotation schedule snapshot from the keystore orchestration service (rotation_schedule_snapshot.csv).
- Pull admin/KMS operator logs for 2028-07-01 to 2028-07-30 (sample_kms_access_logs.txt). These will be filtered for admin operations (CreateKey, ScheduleKeyRotation, RevokeKey, Decrypt, Encrypt) and redacted.
- Locate BYOK handshake excerpts (byok_handshake_log_excerpt.txt) for tenant id = "aurelia-financial".

Jonas — can you expedite HSM attestation (hsm_attestation_2028-07-15.pdf)? We have a vendor-signed attestation from 2028-07-15. Need your signature on the cover letter before we release externally.

Irene
Principal, Security Engineering


From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai; jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Key lifecycle artifacts for SOC2/SIG review

Irene / Jasmine — cover letter signed and returned. I'm attaching the vendor attestation PDF and a short note describing the HSM configuration and tamper-evidence checks. Also adding the rotation cadence summary to the manifest.

Jonas Weber
Director, Cryptography & Inference Runtime

Attachments: hsm_attestation_2028-07-15.pdf (PDF), hsm_config_overview.txt (text)


From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Alex R. <security.audit@aurelia.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 31 Aug 2028 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Delivery: Key lifecycle evidence package (Aurelia Financial)

Alex — attached is the package for Aurelia Financial. Files included in the secure bundle: kms_key_inventory.csv, rotation_schedule_snapshot.csv, sample_kms_access_logs.txt, byok_handshake_log_excerpt.txt, hsm_attestation_2028-07-15.pdf.

Notes and context:
- KMS inventory lists tenant tag "aurelia-financial" on rows for keys we manage for your tenant. Internal keystore IDs are included for traceability; we have redacted service principal ARNs per our disclosure policy.
- Rotation schedule shows policy (automatic rotation every 365 days for CMKs; KEKs are rotated on a 2-year cadence with emergency rotation procedures documented).
- Sample logs are admin-operations only; request_ids are preserved for your correlation, but tenant-specific PII and full request payloads are redacted.
- BYOK handshake excerpt includes the approval tokens and key-fingerprint exchange for the Aurelia tenant.
- HSM attestation is vendor-signed (Thales) dated 2028-07-15; cover letter signed by our Director of Cryptography.

Delivery method: secure ShareFile bundle (link below). Link expires in 30 days and requires the one-time access token we sent via the separate channel.

ShareFile link: https://redwood-sharefile.company/secure/abc123-kms-evidence

If you need additional slices (longer log windows, raw audit trail exports, or SOC2 control mappings), let me know and we can coordinate with our eDiscovery and engineering teams.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_package_manifest.txt (text)
